tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search public OpenStays Property Passports: short-term rentals that guests book directly with the owner. It searches the whole world or one country, region or town, by a property's name, and by any fact a Passport states: bedrooms, bathrooms, beds, guests, property type, amenities such as a pool or

tools.name: get_property_passport
tools.description: Retrieve one Property Passport in full by the passportId of a search_stays result: every fact the owner states, the photos, and the owner's own booking channels in contact_routes, where the guest books. The Passport follows the schema at https://openstays.ai/passport-schema/latest/passport.schema.js
